blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes.
Building on this finding, we introduce GALA ( G aussian A nimation via L inear A pproximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend.
To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/
blocks.zh:
3D高斯活佛支持快渲染,然而,他们的实时动画经常被昂贵的神经推断所挑战. 我们解决了这个瓶颈,并表明,预先训练的外形模型的动画可以由身份独立混合形状的线性组合紧密地相近.
基于这一发现,我们引入了GALA(通过Linear A proximation的Gausian A nimation),一种蒸馏法,用一个浅系数预测器和一个线性混合物来取代每帧重神经分解.
为了提高忠诚度并减少内存要求,我们提议在渲染意识度量衡和内存预算下,使用块-局部五氯苯甲醚构建基础。 我们的方法学习了一个浅薄的MLP网络来预测混合形状系数,并适用于各种动画结构,而无需再培训原始模型. 我们通过加速对面部表情和有服装动力的全能体的3D动画的3D外形模型进行推论来验证GALA. 通过这些模型,我们的蒸馏一般化为被搁置的特性,并降低CPU动画成本可达3个数量级,同时保留了大部分渲染质量. 我们方法的优异结果证实了所学的阿凡达表达方式的共享线性结构,并能够以帧速率,在移动设备上达到可达60fps的高度高效和准确的动画. 项目网页:https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in neural avatars have substantially improved the generation, reconstruction, and animation of photorealistic digital humans. Representations based on 3D Gaussians are particularly attractive because their explicit primitives support efficient rendering ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , and they underlie models for head generation, reconstruction from a single image, and full-body animation with clothing dynamics ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Fazylov et al., 2025 ; Kirschstein et al., 2026 ; Kwon et al., 2026 ) . However, efficient rendering does not imply efficient animation. Many models evaluate a substantial neural network at every frame to update Gaussian attributes from expression or pose parameters, and this per-frame computation, which we call the model’s animation path , can dominate inference cost and limits deployment on CPUs and mobile devices.
blocks.zh: 近代神经活体学的进步,大大地改善了光现实主义数码人类的生成,重建和动画. 基于3D Gaussians的表示特别有吸引力,因为它们的显性原始支持高效渲染(Kerbl等,2023年),它们支撑了头部生成模型,由单一图像来重建,和有服装动力的全身动画(Yu等,2025年;Fazylov等,2025年;Kirschstein等,2026年;Kwon等,2026年). 然而,高效渲染并不意味着高效的动画. 许多模型在每个帧评价一个实质性的神经网络,以从表达或设置参数来更新高斯的属性,这种每帧计算,我们称之为模型的动画路径,可以主导推断成本,并限制CPU和移动设备的部署.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of avatar animation representations. Our method extracts an identity-shared blendshape basis from a pretrained nonlinear avatar model, complementing approaches based on predefined rigs or per-subject fitting. The extracted basis closely approximates the model’s learned deformations and supports efficient linear blending for unseen identities.
blocks.zh: 表1:相声动画表现的比较. 我们的方法从经过预先训练的非线性外形模型中提取出一个身份共享的混合形状基础,补充了基于预先定义的钻机或每个主体的相接方式. 抽取的基础与模型所学得的变形近似,支持有效的线性混合,以获得看不见的身份。

blocks.en: The cost of neural animation raises the question of how much of the computation performed by a pretrained avatar model is necessary at inference time. The complexity of its nonlinear decoder does not establish that its outputs require an equally complex representation, and deformations across identities may share a compact linear structure even when the architecture and the training objective do not impose one. In this work, we show that the animation outputs of diverse pretrained Gaussian avatar models can be closely approximated by an identity-specific neutral avatar and a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes , which we obtain by analyzing Gaussian attribute residuals relative to the neutral state across identities and driving signals. Crucially, a basis extracted once from a model also captures the animation of identities excluded from basis construction, since identity-dependent motion is retained through the blendshape coefficients while the deformation basis is shared.
blocks.zh: 神经动画的成本提出了一个问题:在推论时间,由被预先训练的外形模型进行多少计算是必要的. 其非线性编解码器的复杂性并不能证明其输出需要同样复杂的代表,不同身份的变形可能共享一个紧凑的线性结构,即使结构和培训目标没有强加一个. 在这部作品中,我们显示,各种预先训练的高斯阿凡达模型的动画输出可以被一个身份特异性的中性阿凡达和一个身份独立混合形状的线性组合所紧密地相近,我们通过分析高斯阿凡特属性残存相对于身份和驱动信号的中性状态. 关键是,从模型中提取一次的根据也捕捉到被排除在基建之外的身份的动画,因为依赖身份的运动通过混合形状系数保留,而变形基础则共享.

blocks.en: Linear representations have a long history in face and body modeling ( Blanz & Vetter, 1999 ; Li et al., 2017b ) . More recently, Gaussian blendshape methods have demonstrated efficient photorealistic animation with bases fitted to individual subjects ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zielonka et al., 2025 ) , while systems such as LAM adopt a predefined animation rig ( He et al., 2025 ) . Our work investigates a different setting, extracting a reusable basis from a trained model that represents many identities (Table 1 ). The basis approximates deformations learned by the original network and can be reused for new subjects without reconstructing it, where identity independence refers to sharing within one pretrained model.
blocks.zh: 线性表述在相貌和身体模型方面有着悠久的历史(Blanz & Vetter,1999;Li等,2017b.). 最近,Gaussian混合造型方法展示了高效的光现实主义动画,并配有适合个别对象的基座(Ma等,2024;Zielonka等,2025),而LAM等系统则采用了预先定义的动画钻机(He等,2025)。 我们的工作调查了不同的环境,从代表许多身份的训练有素的模式中提取了可重复使用的基础(表1)。 基础大致为原始网络所学出并可以被再用于新主体而无需重建,其中身份独立性指在一个预先训练过的模型内共享.

blocks.en: Building on this finding, we introduce a Gaussian blendshape distillation strategy, which we call GALA ( G aussian A nimation via L inear A pproximation). Our method constructs separate bases for Gaussian attribute groups and spatial regions using block-local principal component analysis under a rendering-aware metric, which prioritizes deformations that matter for visual fidelity, and allocates components within a memory budget according to their estimated image-space error reduction per stored byte. A shallow coefficient predictor, conditioned on identity and driving signals, then learns to control the extracted basis, so that animation requires only coefficient prediction and a linear blend added to the cached neutral avatar. The procedure requires no retraining of the original model.
blocks.zh: 基于这一发现,我们引入了高斯混凝土蒸馏策略,我们称之为GALA(Gusisan A nimation by Linear A proximation). 我们的方法为高斯属性组和空间区分别构建了基础,在渲染-意识度量下使用块-局部主元件分析,它优先考虑对视觉忠诚有重要意义的变形,并根据每个存储字节的图像-空间误差估计减少量在内存预算范围内分配组件. 一个以身份和驱动信号为条件的浅系数预测器,然后学会控制被提取的基础,因此动画只需要系数预测,并添加到被缓存的中性相声上. 该程序不要求对原有模式进行再培训。

blocks.en:
We apply our approach to three existing models with distinct architectures and training objectives, the hosts of our distillation: AGORA ( Fazylov et al., 2025 ) for head generation, FlexAvatar ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) for one-shot head reconstruction, and DynaAvatar ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) for full-body reconstruction with clothing dynamics.
GALA closely approaches animation accuracy of approximated host models and consistently outperforms other baselines on respective benchmarks.
Crucially, our method increases CPU animation speed of host models by up to three orders of magnitude and enables on-device photorealistic 3D animation at 60 fps.
Figure 1 illustrates qualitative results of our method.
In summary, our contributions are threefold: 1. Identity-independent linearization of neural animation. We demonstrate that animation produced by complex pretrained Gaussian avatar networks can be closely approximated using a shared linear blendshape basis that generalizes to identities unseen during extraction. 2. A method for basis construction and animation control. We introduce GALA, combining rendering-aware, block-local basis construction under a memory budget with a shallow network that predicts blendshape coefficients from the identity and the driving signals. 3. Extensive experimental validation. We apply our method to three existing models for head and full-body animation and demonstrate significant improvements when compared to the state of the art and compact neural baselines.
blocks.zh:
我们将我们的方法应用于三个具有不同建筑和培训目标的现有模式,即我们的蒸馏主机:AGORA(Fazylov等,2025年)用于头部生成;FlexAvatar(Kirschstein等,2026年)用于一发头部重建;DynaAvatar(Kwon等,2026年)用于有服装动力的全身重建。
GALA紧密接近近似主机模型的动画精度,并始终超越各自基准上的其他基线.
关键是,我们的方法将主机模型的CPU动画速度提升了最多3个数量级,并且可以在60英尺高的空间上实现光现实化3D动画.
图1显示了我们方法的质量结果。
总之,我们的贡献有三: 1. 神经动画的特征独立线性化. 我们证明,由复杂、经过预先训练的高斯阿凡达网络制作的动画可以使用一个共享的线性混合形状基础进行近似化,该基础在取出时将一般化为看不见的身份。 2. 基础建设和动画控制方法。 我们引入了GALA,将渲染意识,块-局部基建在内存预算下与从身份和驱动信号中预测混合形状系数的浅层网络结合. 3.广泛开展实验论证. 我们把方法应用到三种现有的头部和全身动画模型中,并且比起艺术状态和紧凑神经基线表现出了显著的改进.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Animatable avatar models. Recent work on photorealistic avatars explores several approaches. 3D-aware GANs trained from unstructured images collections generate heads as triplanes ( Chan et al., 2022 ) or Gaussians ( Kirschstein et al., 2024 ; Hyun & Heo, 2024 ; Barthel et al., 2025 ) , and their animatable versions condition generation on the parameters of morphable models through deformation fields or expression branches ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Bergman et al., 2022 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Fazylov et al., 2025 ) .
One-shot reconstruction methods regress an animatable head from a single image, either by using 3D GANs during training ( Deng et al., 2024a ; Deng et al., 2024b ; Tran et al., 2024 ) or by direct supervised reconstruction from tracked video ( Chu et al., 2024 ; Chu & Harada, 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ; Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion priors pursue the same goal with synthesised supervision ( Taubner et al., 2025b ; Taubner et al., 2025a ) .
Per-subject methods optimise Gaussian avatars from videos of particular people ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Giebenhain et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Work on full-body animation follows similar approaches.
One-shot full-body reconstruction methods ( Qiu et al., 2025 ; Zhuang et al., 2025 ; Sim & Moon, 2025 ) articulate Gaussians by SMPL-X skinning ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) , while DynaAvatar ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) adds pose-dependent clothing dynamics using a transformer conditioned on pose history.
We apply our approach to two recent host models for head animation AGORA ( Fazylov et al., 2025 ) , FlexAvatar ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) and one host model for full-body animation DynaAvatar ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) , and demonstrate significant improvement of their inference speed.
blocks.zh:
Animatatar型号. 近期关于相片现实化的相片相片的作品探索了几种方法. 3D-认识GAN从无结构图像集中培养出头像为tribelanes(Chan等,2022年)或高斯人(Kirschstein等,2024年;Hyun和Heo等,2024年;Barthel等,2025年;Barthel等,2025年),其动能版本通过变形场或表达分支(Sun等,2023年;Wu等,2022年;Xu等,2023年;Bergman等,2022年;Yu等,2025年;Fazylov等,2025年),以可变形模型参数为条件生成.
一弹一发的重建方法使一个可模拟的头从单一的图像中倒退,要么在训练中使用3D GANs(Deng等人,2024a; Deng等人,2024年b;Tran等人,2024年)或通过有跟踪录像直接监督重建 (Chu等人,2024年;Chu & Harada, 2024年;He等人,2025年;Kirschstein等人,2026年;传播前科在合成监督下追求同一目标(Taubner等人,2025年b;Taubner等人,2025年a)。
从特定人群的视频中优化高斯人动画(Qian等,2024;Giebenhain等,2024;Chen等,2024) 关于全身动画的工作也遵循了类似的方法.
一发全体重建方法(邱等,2025; Zhu等,2025;辛等,2025;辛等,2025)由SMPL-X剥皮(Pavlakos等,2019)来阐述高斯人;而DynaAvatar(Kwon等,2026)则使用以造型历史为条件的变压器来添加了依赖姿势的服饰动力.
我们将我们的方法应用于两个最近的主机模型,用于头部动画AGORA(Fazylov等,2025年),FlexAvatar(Kirschstein等,2026年)和一个全能动画DynaAvatar(Kwon等,2026年)的主机模型,并显示出其推论速度有显著的提高.

blocks.en:
Linear face and body models. Linear representations have a long history in modeling human shape and appearance. Eigenfaces represent facial images in a low-dimensional PCA subspace ( Sirovich & Kirby, 1987 ; Turk & Pentland, 1991 ) , while active appearance models capture variations in shape and texture ( Cootes et al., 2001 ) . Three-dimensional morphable models extend this principle to facial geometry and appearance learned from scans ( Blanz & Vetter, 1999 ) .
For animation, blendshape models express deformations as weighted combinations of offsets from a neutral shape ( Parke, 1972 ; Lewis et al., 2014 ) , and multilinear models disentangle identity and expression variation ( Vlasic et al., 2005 ; Cao et al., 2014 ) .
Modern parametric models, including FLAME ( Li et al., 2017b ) and SMPL-X ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) , combine learned shape and corrective blendshapes with articulated skinning to represent expressive faces and bodies; see Egger et al. (2020) for a review of 3D morphable face models.
These representations provide the driving parameters for the avatar models considered in our work. We show that the resulting neural animation outputs themselves admit a compact linear approximation: an identity-shared blendshape basis over Gaussian attributes, extracted from a pretrained network without direct fitting to scans.
blocks.zh:
线性相和体型. 线性表述在人形和外观的建模方面有着悠久的历史. Eigenfaces在低维的PCA子空间中代表了面相图像(Sirovich & Kirby,1987;Turk & Pentland,1991.),而活性外观模型则捕捉出形状和纹理上的变化(Coots等,2001.). 三维可变模型将这一原则扩展至从扫描中吸取的面部几何和外观(Blanz & Vetter, 1999.).
对于动画,混合形状模型表示变形为中性形状相抵的加权组合(Pake,1972;Lewis等,2014;多线性模型分解身份和表达变异(Vlasic等,2005;Cao等,2014.)).
现代参数模型,包括FLAME(Li等,2017b)和SMPL-X(Pavlakos等,2019),将已学习到的外形和矫正的混合形状与清晰的外皮结合,以代表表现面部和身体;关于3D可变面部模型的审查,见Egger等(2020).
这些表述为我们工作中考虑的外形模型提供了驱动参数。 我们显示,由此产生的神经动画输出本身就接受了一个紧凑的线性近似:一个身份共享的混合形状基础,凌驾于高斯的属性之上,从一个事先训练的网络中取出,而没有直接适合扫描.

blocks.en:
Photorealistic blendshape models. Recent work extends blendshape representations to photorealistic Gaussian avatars. Methods such as 3D Gaussian Blendshapes ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , HeadGaS ( Dhamo et al., 2024 ) , Gaussian Déjà-vu ( Yan et al., 2025 ) , RGBAvatar ( Li et al., 2025 ) , GEM ( Zielonka et al., 2025 ) and WebAvatar ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) learn subject-specific bases over Gaussian attributes or latent features from monocular or multi-view observations.
RGBAvatar predicts blending coefficients from tracked expression parameters, while GEM extracts a basis from a trained subject-specific avatar network and predicts its coefficients from images.
Similarly, SqueezeMe ( Iandola et al., 2025 ) distils per-subject full-body Gaussian avatars into linear corrective bases for efficient headset rendering. These methods establish the effectiveness of linear representations for individual avatars, but require a separate basis for each subject.
Fixed-rig approaches such as LAM ( He et al., 2025 ) instead support efficient animation through a predefined FLAME-based articulation model.
Differently from previous work, our method extracts a shared identity-agnostic blendshape basis from a pretrained neural model. The basis captures deformations learned by that model and is reused unchanged for identities unseen during extraction, extending Gaussian blendshape distillation from individual subjects to models of diverse identities.
blocks.zh:
相片现实的混合形状模型. 最近的工作将混合形状的表示扩展到了光现实主义高斯活佛. 3D Gaussian Blendshapes等方法(马等,2024年),HeadGaS (Dhamo等,2024年),高斯琴·德雅活(Yan等,2025年),RGBAvatar(Li等,2025年),GEM (Zielonka等,2025年)和WebAvatar(Zhan等,2026年)从单体或多视图观测中学习高斯人属性或潜在地物的特定主题基础.
RGBAvatar从履带式表达参数中预测混合系数,而GEM则从训练有素的主题特异性网络中取出一个基础,并从图像中预测出它的系数.
同样,挤出 我(Iandola等,2025年)将每个主体的全体高斯活体分解为线性矫正基础来进行高效耳机渲染. 这些方法确定了线性表达法对个体外观的功效,但要求每个主体有单独的基础.
例如LAM(He等,2025年)等固定式设计方法则通过一个预先定义的基于FLAME的表达模型来支持高效的动画.
与前作不同的是,我们的方法从预先训练的神经模型中提取出一个共享的身份-不可知的混合形状基础. 其基础捕捉出该模型所学出的各种变形,对于提取过程中所未见的特征,不加改变地被再用,将高斯混相蒸馏法从单个主体延伸至不同特征的模型.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our goal is to accelerate pretrained Gaussian avatar models ( host models ) by replacing their per-frame neural decoding with a fast inference based on linear blendshape representations. We first introduce a generic host model and its animation parameters in Section 3.1 . Section 3.2 then presents main parts of our method, namely the construction of identity-shared basis
and prediction of its coefficients from animation parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是加速预先训练的高斯阿凡达模型(host models),用基于线性混合形状表示的快速推论来取代其每帧神经分解. 我们首先在第3.1节引入通用主机模型及其动画参数。 然后,第3.2节介绍我们方法的主要部分,即构建身份共享基础
从动画参数来预测它的系数。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en:
We consider avatar models that represent a subject using n n 3D Gaussians rendered by differentiable splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) . Each Gaussian is described by a d d -dimensional attribute vector, which includes position, scale, rotation, opacity, and appearance, with additional skinning weights where required.
Avatar animation is controlled by parameters derived from parametric face or body models such as FLAME ( Li et al., 2017b ) or SMPL-X ( Pavlakos et al., 2019 ) .
We denote the animation driving input by θ \theta and its neutral setting by θ 0 \theta_{0} . For models with temporal conditioning, θ \theta includes the required motion history. An identity descriptor w w , either supplied directly or extracted from an input image, remains fixed throughout an animation sequence.
We define pretrained host models as A ⁡ ( w , θ ) → G ∈ ℝ n ​ d A(w,\theta)\rightarrow G\in\mathbb{R}^{nd} , where the output concatenates the attribute vectors of the n n Gaussians.
Importantly, Gaussian indices in the model output G G must have consistent correspondence across variations in identity and animation parameters. This constraint is typically satisfied by existing models which initialize Gaussians on a shared UV grid or template-anchored point ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Fazylov et al., 2025 ; Kwon et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Because residuals from different identities are factorized jointly, the resulting basis describes shared animation variation. It can also be applied to identities excluded from extraction, provided that Gaussian indices retain the correspondence specified in Section 3.1 . However, this simple construction has three limitations. Attribute groups have different units and scales, global components incur storage costs even for localized deformations, and Euclidean attribute error does not directly reflect rendering quality. We address these limitations through the following modifications.

Each local component stores n j ​ d a n_{j}d_{a} values instead of n ​ d a nd_{a} and encodes a specific spatial region of the avatar. To limit the size of the increased basis U U , we reduce the number of components K a , j K_{a,j} in U a , j U_{a,j} allowing the memory budget to be concentrated on regions with significant variations and complex motion, see below.

blocks.en: We apply our method to three host models with distinct architectures. AGORA ( Fazylov et al., 2025 ) generates heads with a GAN and animates canonical Gaussians with a separate convolutional deformation branch conditioned on FLAME expression and jaw parameters. FlexAvatar ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) reconstructs a head from a single image and regenerates the attributes of all Gaussians at every frame with a transformer decoder conditioned on a FLAME-derived expression code. DynaAvatar ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) reconstructs a full-body avatar with clothing dynamics from a single image and regenerates the Gaussians at every frame with a dynamic transformer conditioned on the current and 15 preceding SMPL-X poses. See Appendix B for more details.

The evaluation protocol of FlexAvatar fits the identity representation w w to the input images of every test subject, and our model follows it with a per-subject enrollment that fine-tunes the coefficient network on outputs of the host model. blocks.en: Our method generates training data by running host models on samples of their inputs ( w i , θ i ) (w_{i},\theta_{i}) . We take these samples from a subset of the training data of the corresponding host models and use them both to construct the basis and to train the coefficient network. For FlexAvatar we use 1,200 training identities with 8 expressions each, and for DynaAvatar we use frames sampled from its training sequences. AGORA is a generative model, hence we sample 10,000 identities from its latent space and combine each of them with 6 expressions of its training set FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) . The results in Tables 2 – 4 and Figure 4 are reported for identities excluded from this data.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that all three distilled models closely follow their host models and outperform the competing methods on most metrics. For AGORA, FID increases from 3.17 to 3.47, while the animation and identity metrics remain within 0.023 of the host model and are the best (AED-jaw, ID, APD) or second best (AED) among the other animatable models. On Ava256 single-shot, our model stays within 0.03 dB PSNR of its host, which outperforms the compared one-shot methods by more than 3.8 dB PSNR under its published protocol ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) . The distilled model therefore retains this lead. With respect to its host, our model stays within 1 dB PSNR in self-reenactment and within 0.03 dB (single-shot) and 0.2 dB (few-shot) on Ava256.

blocks.en:
To further demonstrate the value of our linear blendshape distillation approach, we compare it to a generic method for neural network distillation. Knowledge distillation ( Bucilă et al., 2006 ; Hinton et al., 2015 ) trains a smaller student network to reproduce the outputs of a frozen teacher on the inputs of the teacher. We distill students that are thinner and shallower copies of the animation network of corresponding host models. We train students of multiple sizes using the same training data as we use for training our method.
Figure 4 compares this standard distillation with GALA for a range of memory budgets. For all three host models, none of the distilled networks approaches our method in terms of speed and accuracy.
Additional details of this study are available in Appendix G .

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
While GALA already shows excellent results, its coefficient prediction leaves room for improvement.
With projected coefficients c ⋆ c^{\star} our models reproduce their host models closely, whereas with predicted coefficients their PSNR with respect to the host model is lower by 5.7 dB for AGORA and by 12.3 dB for FlexAvatar at a memory budget of 48 MB, and a larger budget mainly improves the results with projected coefficients (Figure 4 ).
Another direction for improvement concerns the spatial partition, which is currently fixed to B = 32 B=32 blocks for all host models. Meanwhile an optimal partition may depend on the motion and could be selected jointly with the numbers of components K a , j K_{a,j} . Finally, our method inherits the limitations of host models, and our results suggest that avatar models could be trained directly with an identity-shared blendshape basis, which we leave for future work.

另一个改进方向涉及空间分割,目前所有主机模型的空间分割被固定为B=32 B=32个区块. 同时,最佳分区可能取决于运动,并且可以与K a, j K_{a, j}的组件数一起选择。 最后,我们的方法继承了主机模型的局限性,我们的结果表明,可直接用一个身份共享的混合形状基础来培训Avatar模型,我们留作未来工作.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced GALA, which replaces per-frame neural decoding of pretrained Gaussian avatar models with a shallow coefficient network and a linear combination of blendshapes. To the best of our knowledge, GALA is the first method to extract and leverage a blendshape basis shared across identities, whereas previous Gaussian blendshape methods require a separate basis for every subject.
We apply GALA to three diverse avatar models for head and full-body animation and demonstrate excellent computational gains while closely preserving the quality of original models and outperforming recent baselines. GALA requires no retraining of original models, it accelerates CPU execution up to three orders of magnitude and enables animation to run at 60 fps on a mobile phone. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and broad applicability of proposed Gaussian blendshape distillation for efficient, high-fidelity on-device avatar animation.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了GALA,它用一个浅系数网络和一个线性组合的混合形状来取代预先训练的高斯阿凡达模型的每帧神经分解. 就我们所知,GALA是第一个提取和利用各种身份共享的混合形状基础的方法,而之前的高斯混合形状方法要求每个主体有一个单独的基础.
我们把GALA应用于头部和全身动画的三种不同的外形模型,并展示出出色的计算收益,同时密切地保持了原始模型的质量并超越了最近的基线. GALA不需要对原型进行再培训,它加速了CPU可达3个数量级的执行,并使得动画能在手机上以60 fps运行. 这些结果表明,拟议的高斯混凝土蒸馏法对于高效、高纯度的外观动画具有效力和广泛适用性。

blocks.en: Appendix A Rendering-Aware Metric and Basis Construction
blocks.zh: 附录A 人工计量和基础建设

blocks.en:
The rendering-aware metric of Section 3.2.2 is based on the Gauss–Newton Hessian H = J ⊤ ​ J H=J^{\top}J of the rendered image with respect to the Gaussian attributes, which is too large to construct. We approximate it by its per-Gaussian diagonal blocks within each attribute group, which preserve the interactions among the channels of one Gaussian and one attribute group and discard the interactions between Gaussians and between attribute groups. We estimate these blocks with a stochastic estimator in the spirit of the trace and diagonal estimators of Hutchinson (1989) and Bekas et al. (2007) . blocks.en: Appendix B Host Models
blocks.zh: 附录B 主机型号

blocks.en: We apply our method to three host models, spanning different architectures, training objectives, and animation mechanisms. Together, these state-of-the-art models cover dedicated deformation networks, decoders with integrated expression conditioning, and temporally conditioned full-body animation. Table 5 lists the numbers of Gaussians and the attribute groups of the host models together with the settings of our distilled models.
blocks.zh: 我们把方法应用到三个主机模型, 跨越不同的架构,培训目标,以及动画机制。 这些最先进的模型共同覆盖了专用变形网络,具有综合表达条件的解码器,以及时间条件化的全体动画. 表5列出了高斯人的数量和主机模型的属性组以及我们蒸馏模型的设置.

blocks.en: AGORA ( Fazylov et al., 2025 ) is a Gaussian avatar GAN trained adversarially on unstructured images of human heads. It follows the dual-branch design of Next3D ( Sun et al., 2023 ) and GAIA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , using GGHead’s UV-space Gaussian representation ( Kirschstein et al., 2024 ) . A mapping network produces an identity code w w , and an identity branch generates canonical Gaussian attributes on a UV grid aligned with FLAME. A separate deformation branch, conditioned on w w and FLAME expression and jaw parameters θ \theta , predicts attribute residuals. The identity branch is evaluated once per subject, whereas the deformation branch is evaluated at every frame. Identities can be generated by latent sampling or obtained by image inversion.
blocks.zh: AGORA(Fazylov等,2025年)是高斯阿瓦塔人GAN在人类头部无结构图像上接受对抗训练. 它遵循了Next3D(Sun等,2023年)和GAIA(Yu等,2025年)的双分支设计,使用GGHead的UV-space Gaussian代表(Kirschstein等,2024年). 一个映射网络生成一个身份代码w w,一个身份分支在与FLAME对齐的紫外线网格上生成 canonical Gaussian属性. 以w和FLAME表达和下巴参数为条件的一个单独的变形分支 \\theta 预测属性残基. 身份分会每个学科评价一次,而变形分会在每个框架评价一次. 身份可以由潜在取样产生,也可以由图像倒置得到。

blocks.en: FlexAvatar ( Kirschstein et al., 2026 ) reconstructs an animatable head from a single image using an encoder–decoder trained with rendering losses on monocular and multi-view portrait videos. The encoder produces an identity representation in template UV space. A FLAME-derived expression code conditions the decoder through cross-attention. Each animation frame therefore requires evaluating the full decoder to regenerate the attributes of all Gaussians. This model tests whether distillation remains effective when animation is integrated into the decoder rather than implemented by a separate deformation branch.
blocks.zh: FlexAvatar (Kirschstein等, 2026年) 使用训练有素的编码器-解码器从一幅图像上重建出一个动画头部,其渲染损失来自单相机和多相机肖像录像. 编码器在模板紫外空间中生成身份表示. 一个由FLAME衍生的表达码通过交叉意向对解码器进行条件化. 因此,每个动画框架都需要评价全解码器来再生出所有高斯人的属性. 这个模型测试当动画被整合到解码器中而不是由单独的变形分支实施时,蒸馏是否依然有效.

blocks.en: DynaAvatar ( Kwon et al., 2026 ) reconstructs an animatable full-body avatar with clothing dynamics from a single image. Image encoders and a static transformer produce identity features on the SMPL-X template once per subject. A dynamic transformer, conditioned on a window of the current and 15 preceding SMPL-X poses, regenerates the attributes of template-anchored Gaussians at every frame, which are then posed by linear blend skinning. This model tests our method on full-body motion with garment dynamics that depend on the pose history. Its neural animation is by far the most expensive of the three models (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: DynaAvatar (Kwon等, 2026年)从一幅相片中重建出可被想象出全身活化的活化活化活化活化活化相. 图像编码器和静态变压器每个主体一次在SMPL-X模板上产生身份特征. 一个动态变压器,以电流和SMPL-X前15个外形的窗口为条件,在每个帧上再生出模板-安乔德·高斯的属性,再由线性混合剥取而来. 这个模型测试了我们全体运动的方法 服装动力学取决于姿势历史 其神经动画至今是三种模型中最昂贵的(表5).

blocks.en: Our real-time demos run in a web browser on desktop and mobile devices (Figure 5 ). They are built on the open-source WebGL Gaussian splat viewer of Kwok (2023) , whose depth sort and splat rasterizer we keep and whose static point cloud we replace by our animated avatar. The neutral avatar and the blendshape basis are loaded once as textures. At every frame, the browser reads the animation parameters of the driving sequence, evaluates the coefficient network as fragment-shader passes on the GPU, forms the Gaussian attributes as the neutral avatar plus the coefficient-weighted sum of the blendshapes in a second pass, and hands the result to the sort and the rasterizer of the viewer. No host network runs in the browser. The FlexAvatar and DynaAvatar demos can show several avatars at once. The AGORA and FlexAvatar demos use the same viewer and differ only in the animation parameters they read, the FLAME expression and jaw parameters and the tracked expression code respectively, and in the sizes of the basis and the network (Table 5 ). The video on our project page shows the demos in action.

blocks.en: The identity descriptor w w is computed once per identity. For AGORA it is the latent code of the neutral render. For FlexAvatar it is an embedding of the avatar code that the host model fits to the input image, produced by a small encoder with layers of 512 and 256 units that is trained jointly with the network. For DynaAvatar it consists of the pooled identity tokens and the shape parameters of the host’s identity encoder. The animation parameters θ \theta are the ones the host model reads: the FLAME expression, jaw and eyelid parameters for AGORA, the articulation code for FlexAvatar, and the window of the current and 15 preceding SMPL-X frames for DynaAvatar. The two head models use an MLP with two hidden layers on the concatenation of w w and θ \theta . The DynaAvatar network embeds every frame of the window with two layers, applies two temporal convolutions with kernel size 3 over the window, concatenates the flattened result with an embedding of w w , and predicts the coefficients with two hidden layers. Its output is anchored at a reference pose, c ^ = f ϕ ​ ( w , θ ) − f ϕ ​ ( w , θ ref ) \widehat{c}=f_{\phi}(w,\theta)-f_{\phi}(w,\theta_{\mathrm{ref}}) , so that the reference pose gives the neutral avatar for every subject. The last layer of every network outputs the K K coefficients of all attribute groups and blocks.
blocks.zh: 身份描述 ww 在每个身份中计算一次。 对AGORA来说,它是中性成像的潜在代码. 对于FlexAvatar来说,它是一种由主机模型与输入图像相匹配的外形编码的嵌入体,由小编码器所出,分层为512和256个单元,与网络共同训练. 对 DynaAvatar 来说,它包括集合身份符和主机身份编码器的形状参数。 动画参数-\theta是主机模型所读取的:AGORA的FLAME表达式,下巴和眼皮参数;FlexAvatar的发音代码;DynaAvatar的SMPL-X帧前15个的窗口. 两个头型在W和\theta的交接上使用有两层隐藏的 MLP. DynaAvatar网络将窗口的每个框架都嵌入了两层,在窗口上应用了两个有内核大小3的时空演化法,将平分的结果用嵌入w w 来调和,并用两个隐藏的地层来预测系数. 它的输出定位为参考位, c^ = f → (w, θ) → f (w, θ ref )\groundhat{c}=f_{\phi} (w,\theta)-f_{\phi} (w,\thata_{\mathrm{ref}}),这样参考位让每个主题都具有中性动画. 每个网络的最后一层输出所有属性组和块的K系数.

blocks.en: The targets are the projected coefficients c ⋆ c^{\star} of the residuals of the host model with respect to the neutral avatar. The distillation loss of Section 3.2.3 is normalized per attribute group by the coefficient energy of that group on the training data. Every training pair combines an identity with animation parameters taken from elsewhere: an FFHQ expression for AGORA, an articulation code sampled from all training identities for FlexAvatar, and a motion window of another training subject for DynaAvatar, whose 1,035 identity instances are single source images of the 26 4D-Dress subjects and 136 DNA-Rendering ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) actors in the training data of the host model. All networks are trained in single precision with a cosine learning-rate schedule, and the checkpoint is selected on held-out identities, never on frames of the training identities.
blocks.zh: 目标是宿主模型中与中性外星有关的剩余部分的预测系数c ⋆ (c star). 第3.2.3节的蒸馏损失按每个属性组的系数能量在培训数据上正常化。 每对训练结合一个身份与从别处取自的动画参数:AGORA的FFHQ表达,FlexAvatar所有训练身份的标注代码样本,DynaAvatar另一个训练主题的动作窗口,其1,035个身份实例是26个4D-Dress主题和136个DNA-Rendering(Cheng等,2023年)角色在主机模型训练数据中的单源图像. 所有网络都以同位素学习率时间表进行单一精度培训,检查站则选用被扣留的身份,绝不选用培训身份的框框。

blocks.en: Appendix F Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录F 评价详情

blocks.en: Every distilled model is evaluated on the benchmark of its host model. AGORA is evaluated on FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) with the protocol of Sun et al. (2023) . FID compares the distributions of generated and real images and measures image quality, AED and AED-jaw measure the accuracy of the expression and jaw animation, ID measures the consistency of the identity under animation, and APD measures the accuracy of the head pose. DynaAvatar is evaluated on 4D-Dress ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , where PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS measure the pixel-wise, structural and perceptual similarity of the animated avatar to ground-truth images. FlexAvatar is evaluated on portrait animation on VFHQ ( Xie et al., 2022 ) and on 3D avatar creation from one or a few images on Ava256 ( Martinez et al., 2024 ) . Here PSNR and LPIPS measure image quality with respect to the ground truth, AED, APD and the keypoint distance AKD measure animation accuracy, and CSIM, the cosine similarity of face recognition features, measures identity preservation. For AGORA, the rows of Table 2 a are taken from Fazylov et al. (2025) . For FlexAvatar and DynaAvatar, the host rows of Table 2 b and c are measured by us on the checkpoints released by the authors, and the rows of the compared methods are quoted from the host papers.
blocks.zh: 每个蒸馏模型都根据其主机模型的基准进行评估. AGORA在FFHQ(Karras等,2019年)上与Sun等协议(2023年)进行评审. FID比较了生成和真实图像的分布以及测量图像质量,AED和AED-jaw测量了表达和下巴动画的准确性,ID测量了动画下身份的一致性,APD测量了头部外观的准确性. DynaAvatar在4D-Dress(Wang等,2024年)上得到评价,其中PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS测量动画相片与地真相片的像素,结构及感知等同. FlexAvatar在VFHQ上的肖像动画(Xie等,2022年)和从Ava256上的一幅或几幅相片(Martinez等,2024年)上对3Davatar的创作进行评价. 在此,PSNR和LPIPS根据地面真实度测量图像质量,AED,APD和关键点距离AKD测量动画精度,以及CSIM,面相识别特征的同位素相似性,测量身份保存. 就AGORA而言,表2a的行取自Fazylov等人(2025年)。 对于FlexAvatar和DynaAvatar, 表2b和c的东道行由我们在作者释放的检查站上测量,比较方法的一行取自东道主的论文.

blocks.en: We use the checkpoint released by Kwon et al. (2026) and follow their evaluation protocol on 83 sequences and 12,200 frames of the 4D-Dress test split. Our measurement of the host, 23.86 dB PSNR, 0.959 SSIM and 0.063 LPIPS, reproduces the published numbers of 23.74 dB, 0.960 and 0.064 within 0.12 dB. The host and our model are evaluated on the same renders.
blocks.zh: 我们使用由Kwon等人(2026年)发布的检查点,并遵循他们对83个序列和12200帧的4D-Dress测试分拆的评价协议. 我们对宿主的测量,23.86 dB PSNR,0.959 SSIM和0.063 LPIPS,在0.12 dB范围内复制了已公布的23.74 dB,0.960和0.064等数字. 东道主和我们的模型也一样得到评价。

blocks.en: On VFHQ we use the authors’ main model FLEX-1 ( ckpt-900k ) and follow their released VFHQ-Test protocol. On Ava256 we use the released checkpoint FLEX-2-avat3r-eval , which according to the repository was not trained on the Avat3r test identities. The host row, our basis and our coefficient network are all computed from this checkpoint. Kirschstein et al. (2026) specify the structure of the Ava256 protocol, namely one frontal input frame with 10 expressions and 4 cameras per subject for the single-shot setting and four input images per subject following Avat3r for the few-shot setting, but not the particular subjects, sequences or expression frames, and the authors did not respond to our request for them. We therefore instantiate the protocol as follows. Kirschstein et al. (2026) evaluate on 5 subjects that are not identified, so we use all 8 unseen subjects of the authors’ released Avat3r evaluation specification and the EXP_free_face sequence of each subject. The input is the subject’s most frontal calibrated camera at the first frame of the sequence. The targets are evenly spaced frames of the sequence excluding the input frame, each rendered from the subject’s 4 Avat3r input cameras. The host and our model are evaluated on exactly the same identities, input images and target frames. Our numbers for the host consequently differ from those in Kirschstein et al. (2026) , e.g . 19.27 versus 16.9 dB single-shot PSNR over 8 and 5 subjects respectively, and the numbers of the compared methods in Table 2 c are quoted from that paper. Since our method uses the host only through its outputs, the difference between the host and our model is expected to be unchanged under the original evaluation subset. The few-shot setting uses the authors’ released evaluation specification for the Avat3r test identities ( Kirschstein et al., 2025 ) with 8 subjects, 4 input views and 631 target images.
blocks.zh: 在VFHQ上,我们使用作者的主要型号FLEX-1(ckpt-900k)并遵循他们发布的VFHQ测试协议. 在Ava256上,我们使用放行的检查站FLEX-2-avat3r-eval,据寄存器显示,它没有接受过Avat3r测试身份的培训. 宿主行、我们的基础和系数网络都是从这个检查站计算的。 Kirschstein等 (2026) 具体规定了Ava256协议的结构,即一个前置输入框,每个主体用于单发设定时有10个表达式和4个相机,在Avat3r之后每个主体用于几发设定时有4个输入相片,但具体主体,序列或表达相框则不在此列,而作者们并没有回应我们对它们的要求. 因此,我们立即将议定书说明如下。 Kirschstein等人(2026年)对5个未确定的主题进行了评价,因此我们使用了作者公布的Avat3r评价规格和每个主题的EXP_free_face序列的所有8个未见的主题。 该输入器是受试者在序列第一帧最前置校正相机. 目标均匀地相距相框,不包括输入相框,每个相框都取自主体的4 Avat3r 输入相机. 对主机和我们的模型的评价 完全相同的身份,输入图像和目标框架。 因此,我们的东道主人数与Kirschstein等人(2026年)的数字不同,例如:19.27人对18.8%。 16.9 dB 单发PSNR分别超过8个和5个科目,表2c中比较方法的数字取自该文件。 由于我们的方法仅通过其产出使用主机,因此在原评价子集下,主机和我们模式的差异预计不会改变. 数发设定采用了作者发布的Avat3r测试身份评价规格(Kirschstein等人,2025年),包含8个主题,4个输入视图和631个目标图像.

blocks.en: Appendix G Comparison to Alternative Distillation
blocks.zh: 附录G 替代蒸馏的比较

blocks.en: The distilled networks of Figure 4 follow the standard recipe of knowledge distillation ( Bucilă et al., 2006 ; Hinton et al., 2015 ) : a student network is trained with a mean-squared loss on the outputs of the frozen host model, here normalized per attribute group, on the same samples as our bases and coefficient networks. Every student is a reduced copy of the animation network of its host model, and all other parts of the host model are kept frozen. For AGORA, the student is the convolutional deformation branch with fewer channels, initialized from scratch or, for A5, by magnitude pruning of the channels of the host ( Li et al., 2017a ) . For FlexAvatar and DynaAvatar, the student keeps 1 to 8 of the blocks of the transformer that is evaluated at every frame, initialized from the host and reduced in width. The DynaAvatar students additionally attend over a farthest-point-sampled subset of the Gaussians and interpolate the predicted residual to all 40,000 Gaussians. Table 8 lists the size, the CPU time and the quality of every network.
blocks.zh: 图4的蒸馏网络遵循了知识蒸馏的标准配方(Bucilă等,2006年;Hinton等,2015年):一个学生网络接受过冷冻宿主模型输出值平均亏损的培训,这里是每个属性组的常态化,其样本与我们的基数和系数网络相同. 每个学生都是其主机型号的动画网络的减量拷贝,主机型号的所有其他部分被冻结. 对AGORA来说,学生是螺旋变形分支,频道较少,从零开始初始化,对A5来说,通过对主机频道的量级挤压(Li等,2017a. 对于FlexAvatar和DynaAvatar来说,学生保留了变压器的1到8个区块,这些区块在每个帧被评估,从主机初始化并缩小了宽度. DynaAvatar学生还参加一个最远的高斯人样本子集,并将预测的剩余部分插到所有4万高斯人身上。 表8列出每个网络的大小,CPU时间和质量.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares these networks with our method for a range of memory budgets. For all three host models, none of the distilled networks is both faster and more accurate than any of our models, and among the models that run in less than 80 ms the most accurate one is ours. For AGORA and DynaAvatar, none of the distilled networks reaches the quality of our model of Table 2 . The best distilled AGORA network obtains an FID of 3.60 in 124 ms, whereas our model obtains 3.47 in 5.5 ms. For FlexAvatar, only the largest transformer approaches the LPIPS of the host model. It requires 175 ms, which is 40 times slower than our model. All distilled networks faster than 50 ms are less accurate than our smallest model, which has a 12 MB basis and takes 2 ms. The time of our method also grows slowly with memory, e.g . a 17 times larger AGORA basis requires 5 times more time, which we attribute mainly to the memory bandwidth of the CPU. Finally, the difference between our models with predicted and with projected coefficients shows the effect of coefficient prediction on the final quality. For larger budgets on FlexAvatar and DynaAvatar, projected coefficients bring our models close to the host model, which indicates that the remaining error is mostly due to coefficient prediction.
blocks.zh: 图4将这些网络与我们的一系列内存预算方法进行比较。 对于所有三种主机模型来说,没有一种蒸馏的网络既快又准确,都比我们的任何模型都快,在运行不到80米的模型中,最精确的就是我们的了. 对AGORA和DynaAvatar来说,所有蒸馏网络都没有达到表2的模型质量。 最好的蒸馏AGORA网络在124毫秒中获得3.60分的FID,而我们的模型在5.5毫秒中获得3.47分. 对于FlexAvatar来说,只有最大的变压器接近主机模型的LPIPS. 它需要175毫秒,比我们的模型慢了40倍. 所有蒸馏网络速度快于50 ms的精度低于我们最小的模型,它有12 MB的基础并需要2 ms. 我们方法的时间也随着记忆而缓慢地增长,例如. a 17倍更大的AGORA基础需要5倍多的时间,我们将此主要归因于CPU的内存带宽. 最后,我们的模型与预测的和预测的系数的差别表明系数预测对最终质量的影响。 对于FlexAvatar和DynaAvatar的较大预算,预测的系数使我们的模型接近主机模型,这说明剩下的误差大多是由于系数预测.

blocks.en: Per-subject methods fit an avatar to a video or a multi-view capture of each person, whereas our model initializes from one photo through the host model and reuses one shared basis.

blocks.en: Table 9 compares FlexAvatar + GALA with RGBAvatar ( Li et al., 2025 ) on 6 held-out identities of INSTA ( Zielonka et al., 2023 ) , and with GEM ( Zielonka et al., 2025 ) and RGBAvatar on 3 identities of Ava256 ( Martinez et al., 2024 ) . RGBAvatar is fitted to the monocular video of each INSTA subject and, like GEM, to the 15-view capture of each Ava256 subject. Our model initializes from one photo of the subject. Self reenactment is scored on training frames of the per-subject fits (the first 250 frames of each INSTA video, and 120 Ava256 tuples per identity from 4 training cameras, none of them the camera of the input photo) and on held-out frames (the last 350 frames of each INSTA video, and 1,384 Ava256 tuples with unseen motion and mostly unseen views), cross reenactment on 3 VFHQ drivers without ground truth. Both per-subject fits are driven with their released pipelines: RGBAvatar with the drivers tracked by the same tracker and configuration as its training frames, and GEM with its image-based coefficient regressor relative to a neutral reference frame of each driver. Table 10 repeats the comparison with RGBAvatar on 3 short clips of the VFHQ test set ( Xie et al., 2022 ) , where RGBAvatar is fitted to the first 70% of each clip (127 frames on average) with the tracking of its released pipeline, FlexAvatar and our model use the first frame, and self reenactment is scored on the last 20% of each clip, with PSNR and LPIPS on 10 frames per clip. On 4D-Dress ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , WebAvatar ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) is fitted to 24 views of each subject (999 frames per view, 4.8 h) and scored on a held-out take. Figures 6 to 8 show frames.

RGBAvatar被装入每个INSTA主题的单视视频,并和GEM一样被装入每个Ava256主题的15景取景. 我们的模型从一个主题的照片中初始化。 自我再现是在每个主题的训练相框(每个INSTA视频的前250个相框,每个身份从4个训练相框中取出120个Ava256拖拉,其中没有一个是输入相片的相框)和被扣出相框(每个INSTA视频的最后350个相框,以及1 384个Ava256拖拉并带有看不见的动作和大多数看不见的视线)上,在3个VFHQ驱动器上交叉再现,没有地面真相. 每个主体都用其释放的管线驱动:RGBAvatar的驱动器由与其培训框架相同的跟踪器和配置跟踪,GEM的基于图像的系数递减器与每个驱动器的中性参考框架相对. 表10重复了在VFHQ测试集(Xie等,2022年)的3个短片片段上与RGBAvatar的比较,其中RGBAvatar被装入了每个片段的前70%(平均为127帧)并跟踪其已放出管线,FlexAvatar和我们的模型使用第一个片段,自我再现在每片段最后20%的片段上得到分数,其中PSNR和LPIPS每片段10帧. 在4D-Dress上(Wang等,2024年),WebAvatar(Zhan等,2026年)为每个题材的24个取景点(每取景点为999帧,4.8h)并得分被搁置取景. 图6至图8显示帧.

blocks.en: In self reenactment, the per-subject fits score better: they have a lower AED on the held-out frames of every dataset, and RGBAvatar a higher PSNR on INSTA and VFHQ. This is expected. Each per-subject fit minimizes a photometric loss on the very sequence that self reenactment scores, from one video (INSTA, VFHQ) or from 15 views of the capture (Ava256), whereas our model never sees this sequence and is not optimized for its reconstruction. Our higher held-out PSNR on Ava256 comes from the camera of the input photo, on which the per-subject fits were not trained. The intended use of an avatar is cross reenactment, animation by the motion of another person, and there our model is ahead: it has a lower AED and APD than every per-subject fit on all three datasets and a higher CSIM on INSTA and VFHQ, whereas GEM keeps a higher CSIM on Ava256. Figures 6 to 8 show why: on their own held-out frames the per-subject fits are close to the ground truth, but under the motion of the driver RGBAvatar breaks up at head poses absent from its training video and GEM barely opens the mouth, whereas our model follows the driver. On 4D-Dress, WebAvatar obtains 22.78 dB, compared with 21.82 dB for DynaAvatar + GALA and 22.93 dB for DynaAvatar. On their own training frames, RGBAvatar reaches 33.21 dB on INSTA and 23.35 dB on Ava256, whereas GEM reaches 16.64 dB. Two properties of GEM explain its numbers. GEM does not model the neck and shoulders, which its pipeline masks out of its training images and which the ground truth keeps: this region covers 3% of the pixels but 45% of GEM’s squared error, and GEM’s own training image, scored as a render, reaches 19.3 dB. Its fit is also blurry from its first stage, which reaches 21.2 dB against its own neck-free training images before the basis and the coefficient regressor are fitted. On the head region alone, GEM reaches 20.05 dB on its training frames and RGBAvatar 23.92 dB.
blocks.zh: 在自我再现中,每个主体的得分更适合:它们在每个数据集的被扣出框上有更低的AED,而RGBAvatar则在INSTA和VFHQ上有一个更高的PSNR. 这是预期的。 每个受试者都符合从一个视频(INSTA,VFHQ)或从捕捉的15个视角(Ava256)中,将自我再现得分的序列的光度损失最小化,而我们的模型从未看到过这种序列,也没有被优化用于重建. 我们Ava256上更高的PSNR来自输入相片的相机,而每个对象的相机没有经过训练. Avatar的用法是交叉再现,动画是另一个人的动作,我们的模型就摆在前面:它比所有三个数据集上每个主体的AED和APD更低;INSTA和VFHQ上的CSIM更高;而GEM则在Ava256上保持更高的CSIM. 图6至图8显示了为什么:在他们自己所持的框框上,每个对象的相容度接近地面的真相,但是在驾驶员RGBAvatar的动作下,头部被打碎,没有出现在训练录像中,GEM几乎不开口,而我们的型号跟随驾驶员. 在4D-Dress上,WebAvatar获得22.78 dB,而DynaAvatar + GALA获得21.82 dB,DynaAvatar获得22.93 dB. 通过自己的训练框架,RGBAvatar在INSTA上达到33.21分贝,在Ava256上达到23.35分贝,而GEM则达到16.64分贝. GEM的两个属性解释其数字. GEM不建模颈部和肩部,它的管线遮住其训练图像并保存了地面真实性:这个区域覆盖了3%的像素,但占了GEM平方误差的45%,GEM自己的训练图像作为渲染得分,达到了19.3分贝. 从第一阶段开始,它的适应性也模糊不清,在安装基准和系数后退器之前,相对于其自身的无颈训练图像达到21.2分贝. 单是头部区域,GEM在培训框架上达到20.05分贝,RGBAvatar 23.92分贝.

blocks.en: Figure 10 visualizes motions captured by our basis. Each local basis U a , j U_{a,j} is supported on one spatial block (Section 3.2.2 ), hence our blendshapes learn local motions that correspond to particular regions of the avatar, and the same blendshapes produce consistent motions for different identities. As examples we show blendshapes that control an eye for AGORA, the mouth for FlexAvatar, and a moving part of the garment for DynaAvatar, which is shown in the canonical A-pose.
blocks.zh: 图10可视化了我们所了解的运动。 每个本地基 U a, j U_{a, j} 在一个空间块上支持( 第 3.2.2 节), 因此, 我们的混合形状会学习与外形特定区域相适应的局部运动, 同样的混合形状会为不同的特性产生一致的运动。 作为例子,我们展示了控制一只眼睛的AGORA的混合形状,为FlexAvatar的口,为DynaAvatar的外衣的移动部分,这表现在犬科A-pose中.

blocks.en: For the head models, a Gaussian window is placed on a facial region of the shared template, and the components with at least a quarter of their displacement energy inside the window form a group (737 and 945 components for the AGORA rows, 349 and 343 for the FlexAvatar rows). The group is driven along the leading eigenvector of the covariance of its coefficients over the training data, and the two states are the means of the coefficient vectors near the 2nd and the 98th percentile along this direction, applied through the window, with the amplitude for FlexAvatar limited to 14 mm for a head of 230 mm. For DynaAvatar, the first state is the neutral avatar, and the second sets one component to its 2nd or 98th percentile over the training data and the other coefficients to the mean of the nearest 10% of the coefficient vectors, attenuated toward the neutral avatar away from the component. The rows therefore show conditional activations of parts of the basis, not isolated basis vectors. The first column shows the window for the head models and the displacement field of the component for DynaAvatar, normalized per panel. The AGORA and FlexAvatar identities are held out, the DynaAvatar subjects belong to the training data. Bases: 154.1, 48 and 88.3 MB.
blocks.zh: 对于头部模型,一个高斯窗被放置在共享模板的面部区域上,在窗口内至少有四分之一的放行能的组件组成了一组(AGORA行的737和945组件,FlexAvatar行的349和343组件). 该组沿其系数在训练数据上共变的主要精度被驱动,而两个州是沿此方向靠近2和98百分位的系数向量的手段,通过窗口被应用,而FlexAvatar的振幅被限制在一头230毫米的14毫米. 对 DynaAvatar 来说,第一个状态是中性化的avatar,第二个状态将一个成分设定在培训数据的第二或第九十八百分位上,其他系数设定在系数矢量中最接近10%的平均值上,向中性化的avatar 脱离了成分. 因此行显示有条件地活化了部分碱基,而不是孤立的碱基向量. 第一栏显示DynaAvatar组件头型的窗口和移位字段,每个面板正常化. 保留了AGORA和FlexAvatar的身份,DynaAvatar科目属于培训数据。 基数:154.1、48和88.3 MB.
